results.description: Statement changed to claim the substitution rate is 2 mu instead of mu.
results.find: (wrightFisher M hM).fixationProbability (oneCopy M hM)) = μ := by
results.replace: (wrightFisher M hM).fixationProbability (oneCopy M hM)) = 2 * μ := by

results.description: Statement changed to claim a single copy fixes with probability 1/(M+1) instead of 1/M.
results.find: (wrightFisher M hM).fixationProbability (oneCopy M hM) = 1 / M := by

results.description: Statement changed so the fixation probability of i copies tends to i/(M+1) instead of i/M.
results.find: Tendsto (fun t => C.fixedBy t i) atTop (𝓝 (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) / M)) := by
results.replace: Tendsto (fun t => C.fixedBy t i) atTop (𝓝 (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) / (M + 1))) := by

results.description: Model hypothesis removed: the chain no longer has to be able to leave interior states (escape := True). Fixation then need not happen, so the limit theorem must fail.
results.find: escape : ∀ i : Fin (M + 1), i ≠ 0 → i ≠ Fin.last M → 0 < P i 0 + P i (Fin.last M)

results.description: Statement changed to claim the change in mean fitness equals the variance itself, not the variance divided by mean fitness.
results.find: meanFitness (select p w) w - meanFitness p w = variance p w / meanFitness p w := by
results.replace: meanFitness (select p w) w - meanFitness p w = variance p w := by

results.description: Statement changed to claim the odds triple each generation instead of doubling.
results.find: odds (asexualNext q f) = 2 * odds q := by
results.replace: odds (asexualNext q f) = 3 * odds q := by

results.description: Statement changed to claim a favored lineage of i copies fixes with probability at least (i+1)/M instead of i/M. Not true (the neutral chain is favored and fixes with exactly i/M), so the proof must fail.
results.find: ((i : ℕ) : ℝ) / M ≤ C.fixationProbability i := by
results.replace: (((i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) / M ≤ C.fixationProbability i := by
results.firstError: favored-floor-strengthened.lean:233:2: error: linarith failed to find a contradiction

results.description: Statement changed to claim the expected substitutions over T generations are at least 2 mu T instead of mu T.
results.find: μ * T ≤ expectedSubstitutions M μ (C.fixationProbability (oneCopy M hM)) T := by
results.replace: 2 * μ * T ≤ expectedSubstitutions M μ (C.fixationProbability (oneCopy M hM)) T := by
results.firstError: favored-budget-doubled.lean:426:35: error: Application type mismatch: The argument
